"""Shared helpers for building large legal sessions."""
import importlib.util, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
from ref import Topo

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mp', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
M = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(M)
BIN = '/workspace/tmp/unit-merge-build/engine'


def legal(spec, rng, d, g, quota=1, budget=10 ** 12, weight=1, pinmod=0):
    topo = Topo(spec)
    n = topo.n
    by_dom = {}
    for tid, dm in enumerate(topo.domains):
        by_dom.setdefault(dm, []).append(tid)
    doms = sorted(by_dom)
    gkey = [(doms[(i * 7) % len(doms)], i % 4) for i in range(g)]
    tasks = []
    for i in range(d):
        gid = i % g
        dom, cls = gkey[gid]
        pool = by_dom[dom]
        tasks.append([pool[i % len(pool)], gid, weight, cls,
                      1 if (pinmod and i % pinmod == 0) else 0])
    fp = [set() for _ in range(g)]
    for t in tasks:
        fp[t[1]] |= set(topo.foots[t[0]])
    caps = [0] * n
    for gid in range(g):
        if fp[gid]:
            for x in fp[gid]:
                caps[x] += quota
    return topo, {'topology': spec, 'caps': caps, 'groups': [[quota, budget] for _ in range(g)],
                  'tasks': tasks, 'query': {'groups': list(range(min(g, 4))), 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []},
                  'transactions': []}


def engine_time(request, label):
    data = M.transport(request)
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([BIN], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    el = time.time() - t0
    print('%-26s engine %6.2fs out=%d rc=%d head=%s' % (label, el, len(p.stdout), p.returncode, p.stdout[:50]))
    return el
PYEOF
